name: Super Real Mahjong ~P.V~
source:
The fifth work in the "Super Real Mahjong" series, the pinnacle of strip mahjong games.

There are three opponents similar to the previous work, who are good friends and classmates in the second year of high school.

The story is about three girls who are trying to establish a mahjong club at Tsukinami Private High School challenge the protagonist who is rumored to be strong in mahjong, in order to recruit him into the club.

This game features attractive characters and smooth animations besides mahjong games.
translation:
《超级真实麻将》系列第五部作品，脱衣麻将游戏的巅峰之作。

对手是三个和前作类似的人，他们是高二的好朋友和同学。

该剧讲述了在私立月并高中成立麻将社的三名少女向传闻中麻将高手的主人公发起挑战，以招揽他加入麻将社的故事。

除了麻将游戏外，该游戏还具有吸引人的角色和流畅的动画。
